# Customer 360

Concentration, RFM segmentation and product holding for `mart_customer_360`.
All outputs are aggregated; small cells are suppressed before export.

## Concentration

"X% of customers hold Y% of balances" — Gini and top-decile share.

```{r}
#| echo: false
conc <- read_table("customer_concentration")
if (!is.null(conc)) print(conc) else cat("No concentration table in this run.\n")
```

## RFM segment profile

Segments are quantile-scored on recency, frequency and monetary value.
Scores are sample-relative — do not compare across runs without freezing cut points.

```{r}
#| echo: false
prof <- read_table("customer_rfm_profile")
if (!is.null(prof)) print(utils::head(prof, 30)) else cat("No RFM profile in this run.\n")
```

## Methods

See `docs/METHODS.md` for Gini, concentration and RFM assumptions and limits.
PII note: this mart is the most identifier-heavy — IDs are hashed before any export.
